detail.longDescription:
I should be sewing, or just resting and recovering from the lurgy, but no, I'm standing up my blog website again from scratch because AGAIN I found myself in an upgrade path cul-de-sac.

I must upgrade node.js for which I must upgrade Ghost but Ghost dropped support for MariaDB and won't let me unless I switch to MySQL8.

Switching from MariaDB to MySQL8 would be easy IF I didn't also use this host for other things which need MariaDB, and running those DBs side by side is ASS.

#selfhosted
